notes: The STL holds the device twice: the assembly at z = -27..27 and an exploded copy further along -Z (its cover 64 mm away, its frame 132 mm away); only the assembly is kept. It is two parts: the 54 x 54 x 15.5 mm frame, open at the front, with the power key, the reset key, the speaker holes, the M5 mark and the side icons molded into it, and the orange back cover, which stands 1.0 mm proud of the frame (16.5 mm in all). A rotation of +90 degrees about X takes it into the build frame: the STL's +Y (the open front) becomes +Z and its -Z (the face with the label recess) becomes +Y, which puts the power key, USB-C and Grove on the left face and the microSD slot and reset key on the bottom face, as on the vendor photos. The STL has no glass, no display and no connectors, so the black glass (on the frame's ledge at z 9.7, under the rim's top at 11.2), the display window, the touch print, the USB-C receptacle, the Grove housing, the M-Bus header, the two labels, the rubber feet and the cover screws are added here from measurements.json, front.svg and the vendor photos. The board is modeled as the owner uses it, on the M5GO Battery Bottom3 (A014-D, 500 mAh), which replaces the back cover: the cover, its label, feet, screws and the M-Bus header in it are left out, and the base is stacked under the frame as a module from its own vendor file. That file is the base's shell alone, 54 x 54 x 9.0 mm, in the build frame already (its Grove side on +Y, the core's top edge; its open top on +Z), with its two light diffusers as separate pieces; a translation of -7.8 mm along Z puts its rim (z 3.5 in its file) on the frame's back ring (z -4.3), its corner lips nesting inside the frame. The shell holds the LEGO tubes, the 2 x 2 studs, the feet pockets, the screw counterbores and the debossed marks by the pogo pins; the four felt feet (9.0 mm across, 0.3 mm proud), the four M3 cap screws in the counterbores, the brass M3 insert, the four pogo pins, the two Grove housings (PORT.C blue, PORT.B black), the white PORT tag between them and the IR LED above it are added here from the shop photos, and the battery, the board and the header inside the shell are filler. The model's origin is the center of the 54 x 54 x 23.5 mm body, the frame's front rim (z 11.2) to the base's floor (z -12.3); the feet stand 0.3 mm below it.
